## Assignment

Issue/source ID and full versus partial scope. Use Refs for partial work.

## Changes

Problem, resulting behavior, scope/exclusions and material design deviations.

## Evidence

Acceptance -> command/inspection -> actual result, environment and full revision.
Distinguish passed, failed, skipped and pending checks; identify dirty content.

## Documentation

Updated paths and purpose, or a reasoned no-impact statement. Reassess final diff.

## Remaining

Integration, required review, archive or publication obligations and next action.
